{{Quote|For the best mines in the galaxy, buy Merr-Sonn!|Recorded advertisement from [[Land mine/Legends|land mine]]|<ref name="Beyond">''[[Episode I Adventures 11: Pirates from Beyond the Sea]]''</ref>}}
'''Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.''', also known as '''MSM''', was one of the three top weapons manufacturers in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], falling only slightly below [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] in total revenues.

The company boasted a huge line of personal and vehicle weapons in addition to artillery and starship weapons, electronic targeting systems, and personal defenses. Subsidiary companies produced everything from heavy artillery to siege weapons. They also rounded out their product line with electronic sights, armor, and other targeting equipment.

==History==
Merr-Sonn had been in existence for thousands of years and first began its rise to power during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and the [[Mandalorian Wars]], during both of which the company sold weapons to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]. Merr-Sonn did well again during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], providing weapons and equipment to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The company was neutral during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]&mdash;because its holdings were very widely spread out&mdash;and remained highly autonomous during the [[New Republic era]].<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
